0.9.4 衰减图标与朽败调整 / Fading icons and Putrefaction adjustment
接入提供的衰减敏捷、衰减力量图标，去除背景，保留碎片和飘带，等比缩放并居中。状态图标与粒子/详情纹理均使用原版128像素规格，对照原版状态节点检查比例。
朽败被消耗时失去生命从5点改为3点，中英文卡牌、事件说明和工坊介绍同步，费用与关键词不变。
通过原版实际消耗命令验证扣3血，以及图标加载、透明度、居中、显示比例和原版状态节点截图检查。
Adds the supplied Fading Dexterity and Fading Strength icons with transparent backgrounds, preserved aspect ratio and centered native-size 128px textures. Putrefaction now loses 3 HP when Exhausted (previously 5); cost and keywords are unchanged. Chinese/English descriptions and Workshop references updated. Verified the native Exhaust command and rendered native status widgets against Dexterity/Strength.
